urls.title: Site URLs
urls.description: Public URLs to audit, one per line. A bare domain (example.com) is checked over https://.

maxBundles.title: Max JavaScript files per site
maxBundles.description: How many first-party JS files (including lazy-loaded chunks) to download and scan for leaked keys.

lighthouse.title: Also run Lighthouse (mobile)
lighthouse.description: Load each site in headless Chrome with Lighthouse's mobile preset: performance, accessibility, best-practices and SEO scores, LCP/CLS/TBT, page weight, the biggest savings, a combined score and three plain-language findings with a fix scope. Adds about 10-60 s per site. Give the run at least 1024 MB of memory (2048 MB recommended).
